data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that provides an ExpansionTile with rounded corners using only core Flutter widgets.
data.what_it_does: It wraps a ListTile and a ListView to create an expandable tile. The tile can have custom shape, duration, curve, and trailing icon. The children are shown when expanded.
use_when: You need a simple expandable tile with rounded corners
You want to avoid external dependencies and use only Flutter core widgets
You need a quick, lightweight solution for a single-purpose widget
avoid_when: You need advanced animation or custom state management
You require complex nested expansion logic or theming beyond basic shape
weaknesses: No built‑in state management or theming beyond shape
No support for complex child layouts or dynamic data
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec and import the widget; no permissions or build_runner needed
